signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-25 ppt-web-core contexts/OrganizationProvider.tsx). Signals cross-referenced from .research/signals/2026-09-25-ppt-web-core-tier1d.json.
evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/OrganizationProvider.tsx:8-10 rebuilds the context value on every render; not wrapped in useMemo.

OrganizationProvider consumes useAuth() and re-renders on every AuthContext change (silent token refresh spreads a new user object). Every context consumer sees a new value identity even when org fields are unchanged.
Impact: render-perf smell on memoized selectors + useEffect deps keyed on the context object. Fix: wrap in useMemo([user?.organizationId, user?.organizationName]).
